title: E-FRC-0182: the exact lattice Landau spectrum of the charged fear walk: in the Landau gauge each $k_y$ reduces the...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0182 in the gauge arena: the exact lattice Landau spectrum of the charged fear walk: in the Landau gauge each $k_y$ reduces the walk to a strip whose eigenphases, lifted onto E-FRC-0176's torus, are that torus beat's own levels, and E-FRC-0176's measured Landau levels sit on them, so the 9 to 23 percent shortfall from 2 q B is the walk's lattice band, which Onsager's rule with the band's full shape reproduces and whose first order is 2 beta omega_c (n + 1).
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
